title: Silk Roads: local exchange becomes a network

narration_and_visual_sequence.narration: Merchants exchanged goods at intermediate stops.
narration_and_visual_sequence.relationship: Successive local exchanges connect distant places.
narration_and_visual_sequence.action: Move into one exchange; transfer one recognizable object between merchants.

narration_and_visual_sequence.narration: Goods and ideas spread through repeated exchanges.
narration_and_visual_sequence.relationship: Local interactions compose the larger network.
narration_and_visual_sequence.action: Follow the object through a second exchange, then pull back along its route.

narration_and_visual_sequence.narration: Distinct cultures became linked across the network.
narration_and_visual_sequence.relationship: The large network is explained by the exchanges already seen.
narration_and_visual_sequence.action: Pull back to a simplified network; retire close-up labels.

improvement_target: The source is a useful starting point, not the finish standard: repeated camels and small distant nodes compete. Improve character silhouettes and goods, enlarge the active exchange, simplify inactive routes, and let each new narrated relationship change the picture. Preserve the coherent oasis-to-network transition.
adaptation: Borrow explanatory structure and object continuity. Selected STYLE.md governs artwork. Do not copy topic facts, timing or imperfections.
